_comment: Direct head-to-head reproduction of Mancilla, Bouloumis & Goguikian (2025), arXiv:2602.14827 — cardinality-constrained (K=5 of N=10) long-only mean-variance, monthly walk-forward over 2025, 180-day lookback, 5 bps transaction costs. Objective matches theirs: q·wᵀΣw−(1−q)·μᵀw with q=0.3 ⇒ risk_parameter P=0.7. Bounds 0.05≤w≤0.50, Σw=1. REPRODUCTION CHECK: the Zgodovinski+SA row should land near their reported SA Sharpe≈1.31 (they use classical historical μ/Σ + simulated annealing). CAVEAT: their estimation window is 180 trading days; our historical-μ rolling window is tied to sequence_length (=45) — exact lookback match would need a small code tweak, so treat the reproduction as directional. Single-year, 10-asset test → high variance; this is a reproducible SHOWCASE datapoint, not headline evidence.

portfolio._comment: Mancilla et al. (2025) problem: K=5 of 10, long-only, box 0.05..0.50, q=0.3 ⇒ P=0.7.
